# Upstream record: universal_ble

The native layer of ble_shield is derived from
[universal_ble](https://github.com/Navideck/universal_ble) (BSD 3-Clause,
[LICENSE](universal_ble/LICENSE)). It is imported by a script, so the import is
reproducible and an upstream fix can be ported through the same filter.
The `tool/` scripts named below belong to the development repository and are
not part of the published package.

## Base

| | |
|---|---|
| Upstream | `https://github.com/Navideck/universal_ble` |
| Base | `317bbb1` (release 3.2.0) |
| Local checkout used | the 3.2.0 tag plus the restoration patch (`46d12e9`) |
| Pigeon | 29.0.12 (`pubspec.yaml` `dev_dependencies`) |

## What is imported, and where it goes

`tool/vendor_universal_ble.sh <checkout> <ref>` copies the central-role
sources and drops everything else.

| Upstream | ble_shield |
|---|---|
| `lib/universal_ble.dart` (barrel) | `lib/src/native/native.dart` |
| `lib/src/**` | `lib/src/native/**` (`universal_ble` → `ble_shield_native` in file names) |
| `pigeon/universal_ble.dart` | `pigeon/ble_shield_native.dart` |
| `android/**` | `android/**` (package dir `io/github/tganzerli/ble_shield`) |
| `darwin/universal_ble/**`, `darwin/universal_ble.podspec` | `darwin/ble_shield/**`, `darwin/ble_shield.podspec` |
| `test/**` | `test/native/**` (`test/fixtures/` kept in place) |
| `LICENSE` | `third_party/universal_ble/LICENSE` |
| `lib/src/universal_ble_web/universal_ble_web.dart` | not imported by the script; ported by hand to `lib/src/web/` (see below) |
| Linux, Windows, macOS app, example, HIL, docs, skills | not imported |
| Any path containing `Peripheral`/`peripheral` | not imported (central only) |
| `*.g.dart`, `*.g.kt`, `*.g.swift` | not copied: regenerated by Pigeon |

## Renames (applied in this order)

| From | To | Where |
|---|---|---|
| `com.navideck.universal_ble`, `com/navideck/universal_ble` | `io.github.tganzerli.ble_shield`, `io/github/tganzerli/ble_shield` | all |
| `com.universalble.` | `io.github.tganzerli.ble_shield.` | all |
| `UniversalBlePlugin` | `BleShieldPlugin` | all |
| `UniversalBle` / `universalBle` | `BleShieldNative` / `bleShieldNative` | all |
| `package:universal_ble/universal_ble.dart` | `package:ble_shield/src/native/native.dart` | Dart |
| `package:universal_ble/src/` | `package:ble_shield/src/native/` | Dart |
| `dev.flutter.pigeon.universal_ble.` | `dev.flutter.pigeon.ble_shield.` | Dart |
| `universal_ble` / `universal-ble` | `ble_shield_native` / `ble-shield-native` | Dart |
| `universal_ble` / `universal-ble` | `ble_shield` / `ble-shield` | native |

The Pigeon options block is rewritten: `dartPackageName: 'ble_shield'` (channel
prefix `dev.flutter.pigeon.ble_shield.*`), outputs under the new paths, no C++.
Vendored Dart keeps upstream's lint set (`analysis_options.yaml` written into
`lib/src/native/`, `test/native/` and `pigeon/`).

## Local patches (on top of the import)

| Commit subject | What | Why |
|---|---|---|
| `refactor(native): drop peripheral mode` | Removes the peripheral Pigeon APIs, models and enums, the Android advertise-permission channel, the wiring in both plugins, the peripheral Dart models/typedefs/exports and their tests; drops the Web/Linux branches of `_defaultPlatform`; replaces flutter_web_bluetooth's `NotFoundError` with a `StateError` | ble_shield is central only; no `bluez`/`dbus`/`flutter_web_bluetooth` in the resolution |
| `feat(darwin): port per-process restoration ownership` | Upstream `317bbb1..46d12e9` through `--patch`: `configureRestoration` channel and per-identifier owners | several engines in one process |
| `feat(native): create the iOS central lazily and report adapter state from it` | No manager at registration, no default restoration identifier and no Info.plist key (restoration only through `configureRestoration`); adapter state always from a real manager (removes the authorization shortcut); own Android request codes (16-bit) | restoration claimed by the plugin at registration; stale "Bluetooth off" banner; two plugins on one Activity |
| `docs: third-party notice, upstream record, README and CHANGELOG` | `darwin/ble_shield.podspec` summary and description | the template text named no product |
| `fix(scan)!: make the scan watchdog opt-in and non-destructive, forward native scan failures` | New `onScanFailed(int)` on the callback channel; Android `ScanCallback.onScanFailed` and SafeScanner's start exception call it (not its own throttled `SCANNING_TOO_FREQUENTLY`); the platform interface turns it into an error on `scanStream` | a dead scanner used to be only logged on Android |
| `feat(native): report the MTU and allow native logs in release` | New `onMtuChanged(deviceId, mtu)` on the callback channel: Android sends it on every successful `onMtuChanged`, requested or not; Apple on `didConnect` with `maximumWriteValueLength(.withoutResponse) + 3`. The platform interface gains `onMtuChange`/`updateMtu` (with a body, so fakes keep compiling). `BleShieldNative.setLogLevel` loses its `kDebugMode` guard | the negotiated MTU never reached Dart; a release build could not turn on native logs to diagnose a slow link |
| `feat(web): add a Web Bluetooth native layer on dart:js_interop` | `_defaultPlatform()` returns `defaultNativePlatform()` from a conditional import (`lib/src/web/default_platform.dart`, or `default_platform_web.dart` when `dart.library.js_interop`); the Pigeon channel import moves there | the Web layer lives outside the vendored tree, so a full import does not delete it |
| `fix(android): keep one GATT client per device` | `connect()` reuses a pending autoConnect or closes the previous client before `connectGatt`; late events from a replaced client ignored; `GattRegistry.put` returns the replaced client; discovery-only client closed on every path | orphan clients with live connections |

## The Web layer (`lib/src/web/`)

Not vendored: the script never writes `lib/src/web/`, and a full import
leaves it in place. It is a hand port of upstream's `universal_ble_web.dart`
at the base above, with `flutter_web_bluetooth` replaced by ble_shield's own
`dart:js_interop` bindings (`js_bluetooth.dart`, `js_web_bluetooth_backend.dart`)
behind `WebBluetoothBackend`, so `BleShieldNativeWeb` runs on the VM in tests.
Changes against upstream:

- no `startScan` chooser and no `watchAdvertisements`: `startScan` throws
  `notSupported`, and the chooser is `requestDevice` only;
- browser errors mapped to native codes in one place (`_mapError`), including
  the dismissed chooser (`operationCancelled`);
- notification subscriptions keyed by `(deviceId, service, characteristic)`
  instead of a string matched with `contains`;
- `getAvailability() == false` reports `poweredOff` (upstream: `unknown`).

An upstream fix to `universal_ble_web.dart` is ported to these files by hand.

## Porting an upstream change

1. `tool/vendor_universal_ble.sh --patch <checkout> <old-ref>..<new-ref>`
   vendors both refs into temp dirs, diffs them (generated files excluded) and
   applies the diff here with `--reject`.
2. Resolve any `*.rej` by hand (peripheral code that no longer exists here is
   the usual cause), then `tool/vendor_universal_ble.sh --pigeon`.
3. `tool/check_pigeon.sh`, `flutter analyze`, `flutter test`, and the Kotlin
   tests (`cd example/android && ./gradlew :ble_shield:testDebugUnitTest`).
4. Update the base and the patch table above.

To audit the import itself, run the full import on a scratch branch
(`tool/vendor_universal_ble.sh <checkout> 317bbb1`) and compare with the import
commit: they must match.

## Build checks

- `tool/check_resolution.sh`: resolves ble_shield next to `battery_plus ^7.1.1`
  and `flutter_blue_plus 2.1.1`; `--control` does the same with universal_ble
  3.2.0 and is expected to fail.
- iOS is built with Swift Package Manager (`example/`, the default) and with
  CocoaPods in a disposable copy of `example/` created with
  `enable-swift-package-manager: false` (switching an existing project off
  SwiftPM needs manual Xcode cleanup).
